summary: Completed comprehensive testing of RC-10 (persistent rate-limit) and RC-11 (money as integer) plus regression tests for RC-01, RC-05, RC-02, anti-double-booking, and RC-07. All backend tests passed (52/52). Frontend smoke tests passed - login, dashboard KPIs, bookings page, and payment flow all working correctly with whole rupiah amounts displayed throughout.
